A11Y-001.rationale: The replacement executes the real Axe engine inside a real browser process.

A11Y-002.rationale: One declared node can scan an explicit bounded list of application routes.

A11Y-003.rationale: Named profiles make browser and viewport selection visible in reviewed source.

A11Y-004.rationale: The provider includes deterministic desktop and mobile Chromium profile defaults.

A11Y-005.rationale: Operator policy and the production preflight require Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browser engines; the deployed execution remains production-pending.

A11Y-006.rationale: Provider details record the exact version reported by each running browser.

A11Y-007.rationale: Every route and profile combination receives a new isolated browser context.

A11Y-008.rationale: An operator limit bounds concurrent combination execution inside the capability.

A11Y-009.rationale: The provider passes the reviewed project tag list directly to Axe.

A11Y-010.rationale: The provider applies each reviewed excluded selector to the Axe builder.

A11Y-011.rationale: Every unaccepted violation node contributes a blocking failed result count.

A11Y-012.rationale: An acceptance applies only to one exact rule, route, and selector tuple.

A11Y-013.rationale: The strict schema requires a useful reason and an explicit expiry date.

A11Y-014.rationale: The provider ignores an acceptance after its final UTC expiry instant.

A11Y-015.rationale: Accepted violations stay in findings with their reason and expiry date.

A11Y-016.rationale: Incomplete Axe rules remain visible as informational review findings.

A11Y-017.rationale: The provider writes the complete Axe result without duplicated image bytes.

A11Y-018.rationale: Failed elements produce separate bounded PNG screenshot evidence files.

A11Y-019.rationale: Operator policy bounds combinations, concurrency, execution, results, and screenshots.

A11Y-020.rationale: Only operator origins and exact typed fixture origins authorize navigation.

A11Y-021.rationale: Real HTTP, WebSocket, popup, redirect, and WebRTC egress paths are denied at browser-context scope.

A11Y-022.rationale: Completion and errors close contexts and browser processes; deployed cancellation remains part of production acceptance.

A11Y-023.rationale: Project setup converts safe routes, tags, exclusions, time, and deployment input.

A11Y-024.rationale: Project setup stops numeric threshold migration and requests exact acceptances.
